backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report placeholder with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short descriptions of all frontend components and configuration files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide explaining how to build and deploy the app to the Internet Computer, including custom domain steps and verification checklist.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining OKLCH color variables, themes, and base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling forgiveness state and rendering interactions, animations, and footer.
frontend/src/components/ApologyInteracti: Interactive prompt with Yes/No buttons where the No button moves randomly and displays escalating prompts.
frontend/src/components/BeggingCatAnimat: Animated begging cat component built from styled divs with ears, eyes, tears, paws, and body.
frontend/src/components/FallingEmojis.ts: Continuously spawns and animates falling sad emojis with timed cleanup.
frontend/src/components/HeartsBurst.tsx: Creates a short-lived burst of animated hearts with randomized positions and sizes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity, invalidating other queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity login, logout, identity loading, and status handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder module exporting nothing, as no backend queries are needed.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, CSS variables, global styles, and various custom animations for the UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project configuration, feature requirements, domain choice, and design notes for the interactive apology site.
